summary: OFFLINE-UPLOAD-001 P1 fix verified end-to-end. Seeded IndexedDB (keyval-store/keyval @ masci.resiliency.queue.v1) with malformed Daily Report (object lastError, body=null, status=failed, tries=5) plus a normal pending DR, then exercised: drawer render without crash, per-item Discard with inline Cancel/Confirm, Retry All on remaining item, close-drawer reset of confirmingId, and DrawerErrorBoundary path with [null, deeply-malformed] seed. All 5 scenarios PASS — drawer never blanks the page, defensive renderer coerces non-string lastError + bad types, discardQueueItem(id) export removes only the targeted item, normal item persists, and confirm state resets on close.
critical_code_review_comments: QueueStatusPill.jsx defensive helpers (_errorTextOf, _safeId, _safeTries, _formTypeOf, _projectOf) correctly coerce all rendered values to strings/numbers; React-child crash root cause eliminated.
DrawerErrorBoundary scoped only to the items list — header/footer/Retry All remain interactive even if boundary trips. Good blast-radius containment.
discardQueueItem in resiliencyQueue.js is pure (no retry/backoff change), persists via _persist() and notifies subscribers — matches doctrine. Filter is null-safe (`it && it.id !== id`).

Minor (non-blocking): onClearAll iterates items but uses _safeId which can produce `legacy-<index>` for items without id. Those synthetic ids will not match any persisted entry, so a corrupted item that lacks a real id won't actually be removed by Clear-Corrupted. Consider clearing the whole queue (set([]) or del(QUEUE_KEY)) inside the boundary fallback for guaranteed recovery.
Minor: lastError JSON.stringify in _errorTextOf will throw on truly circular objects (caught -> returns 'error'). Acceptable, but a structured-clone path or safe-stringify would be more informative.
seed_data_creation: Seeded IndexedDB DB='keyval-store', store='keyval', key='masci.resiliency.queue.v1' with two payload sets via page.evaluate raw IDB API: (A) malformed Daily Report {lastError: object, body: null, status: failed, tries: 5} + normal pending Daily Report {body:{project_name:'Trench A-7'}, status: pending}; (B) [null, deeply-malformed-broken-item] for ErrorBoundary path. DB cleared at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pill only mounts when queue has items — always seed IDB before reload. Use raw indexedDB.open API (not idb-keyval) via page.evaluate; objectStore name is 'keyval'. Pill testid changes by state: queue-status-pill-failed | -queued | -synced. Confirm box only renders when QueueItemRow's local confirming===safeId. discardQueueItem matches by item.id (idempotencyKey or generated id), NOT by the safeId fallback `legacy-<index>` — make sure seeded items always carry a real `id`.
rca of the issue: Original blank-screen crash: legacy IDB queue entries stored lastError as an object ({message, detail}). The previous QueueStatusPill rendered `{item.lastError}` directly as a React child, throwing 'Objects are not valid as a React child', which propagated to the root since there was no boundary. Fix: (1) _errorTextOf() coerces any lastError shape (string/number/object/Error/axios-like) to a renderable string capped at 240 chars; (2) DrawerErrorBoundary contains rendering exceptions to the items list and offers Clear-corrupted; (3) closeDrawer resets confirmingId; (4) new discardQueueItem(id) export removes a single entry without touching retry/backoff/MAX_TRIES. Verified live.
